phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Tavor TAR-21 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 5.56×45mm NATO primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 430 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 430 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 460 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 6-groove bore and accelerates to 910 m/s (1655 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Long-Stroke Unlock & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 30-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the Tavor TAR-21 staged for its 750–900 RPM cyclic · CQB-optimized balance cadence.

zh.headline: IWI 塔沃尔 TAR-21 无托突击步枪：2001 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 以色列 IWI 塔沃尔 TAR-21 将加利尔系长行程活塞的极端防沙可靠性注入现代一体化高强度复合材料无托壳体，在仅 720 mm 总长内塞入 460 mm 全尺寸步枪管，兼顾装甲车内与城市巷战敏捷性及 550 米弹道威力。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Tavor TAR-21 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 2001 年问世的 IWI 塔沃尔 TAR-21 无托突击步枪 由以色列以色列武器工业公司（IWI）主导研制，定位为经典的无托式突击步枪。TAR-21 名称意为「21 世纪塔沃尔突击步枪」，自 2001 年起逐步取代以色列国防军步兵旅的 M16/M4，并衍生出更紧凑的 X95 微型塔沃尔。
以色列 IWI 塔沃尔 TAR-21 将加利尔系长行程活塞的极端防沙可靠性注入现代一体化高强度复合材料无托壳体，在仅 720 mm 总长内塞入 460 mm 全尺寸步枪管，兼顾装甲车内与城市巷战敏捷性及 550 米弹道威力。 整件装备总长 720 mm（极短紧凑全长 · 460 mm 枪管）、空重 3.27 kg，成为同期无托式步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。2001 年，以色列以色列武器工业公司（IWI）推出了划时代的IWI 塔沃尔 TAR-21 无托突击步枪。TAR-21 名称意为「21 世纪塔沃尔突击步枪」，自 2001 年起逐步取代以色列国防军步兵旅的 M16/M4，并衍生出更紧凑的 X95 微型塔沃尔。 它的核心设计聚焦于将长行程导气活塞与 7 突笋回转枪机融于全封闭防尘高分子壳体，抗风沙能力出众，奠定了其在无托式步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: IWI 塔沃尔 TAR-21 无托突击步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「长行程导气活塞（AK/加利尔系可靠基因）· 7 突笋 AR 系回转枪机」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，长行程导气活塞带动枪机框完成自由行程并驱动旋转闭锁解锁，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用橄榄绿军规防腐涂层钢与增强聚合物精加工而成。通用北约 STANAG 30 发弹匣，并支持左右手互换抛壳口与枪机头，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。IWI 塔沃尔 TAR-21 无托突击步枪 采用长行程导气活塞（AK/加利尔系可靠基因）· 7 突笋 AR 系回转枪机。在每个击发周期中，长行程导气活塞带动枪机框完成自由行程并驱动旋转闭锁解锁。借助橄榄绿军规防腐涂层钢与增强聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了通用北约 STANAG 30 发弹匣，并支持左右手互换抛壳口与枪机头。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 5.56×45mm NATO 弹药规格与 460 mm（18.1 in）冷锻镀铬枪管（6 条右旋 · 178 mm / 1:7 缠距），最高工作膛压约 430 MPa，可赋予弹头 910 m/s 的出膛初速与 1,655 J 动能，有效作用距离达 550 米。
内膛技术特点方面，18.1 in 冷锻镀铬枪管充分加速 SS109/M855 弹头，同时保持比 M4 更短的总长。同时，重心紧贴抵肩部位，支持单手持枪快速切角且机械后坐力直导肩窝，令其在 750–900 发/分（全自动）· 城镇巷战优化 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 460 毫米身管与 5.56×45mm NATO 口径，IWI 塔沃尔 TAR-21 无托突击步枪 实现了每秒 910 米的初速与 550 米有效射程。18.1 in 冷锻镀铬枪管充分加速 SS109/M855 弹头，同时保持比 M4 更短的总长，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 42 mm 膛轴设计，IWI 塔沃尔 TAR-21 无托突击步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 5 N·s 水平。标配 MARS 反射红点与激光集成瞄准镜及折叠式应急机械照门。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-46）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，标配 MARS 反射红点与激光集成瞄准镜及折叠式应急机械照门。欢迎在 BAY-46 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 IWI 塔沃尔 TAR-21 无托突击步枪 的机械魅力。

en.headline: IWI Tavor TAR-21: The 2001 Mechanical Legend
en.deck: IWI’s Tavor TAR-21 houses a desert-proven long-stroke piston and 7-lug rotating bolt inside a sealed composite bullpup chassis—fitting an 18.1-inch barrel into 720 mm for mechanized infantry and urban operations. Preserved in 1:1 interactive 3D CAD scale across all 20 functional assemblies in BAY-46.

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Tavor TAR-21
paragraphs: Introduced in 2001 by Israel Weapon Industries (IWI) in Israel, the IWI Tavor TAR-21 emerged as a defining Bullpup Assault Rifle. Named “Tavor Assault Rifle — 21st Century,” the TAR-21 was adopted by IDF infantry brigades starting in 2001 and later evolved into the even more compact X95.

IWI’s Tavor TAR-21 houses a desert-proven long-stroke piston and 7-lug rotating bolt inside a sealed composite bullpup chassis—fitting an 18.1-inch barrel into 720 mm for mechanized infantry and urban operations. Measuring 720 mm (Ultra-Compact Bullpup · 460 mm Barrel) at an unloaded weight of 3.27 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Assault & Battle Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 2001, Israel Weapon Industries (IWI) of Israel introduced the IWI Tavor TAR-21. Named “Tavor Assault Rifle — 21st Century,” the TAR-21 was adopted by IDF infantry brigades starting in 2001 and later evolved into the even more compact X95. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Long-stroke piston and 7-lug bolt sealed inside an impact-resistant composite bullpup shell — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the IWI Tavor TAR-21 sits its Long-Stroke Gas Piston (Galil Reliability Lineage) · 7-Lug Rotating Bolt in Sealed Bullpup. Throughout every firing cycle, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt, containing 430 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in OD-green protective-coated steel and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Accepts standard NATO STANAG magazines with reversible left/right ejection and bolt heads, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The IWI Tavor TAR-21 relies on Long-Stroke Gas Piston (Galil Reliability Lineage) · 7-Lug Rotating Bolt in Sealed Bullpup. During each cycle, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt. Machined from OD-green protective-coated steel and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Accepts standard NATO STANAG magazines with reversible left/right ejection and bolt heads.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 5.56×45mm NATO with 460 mm (18.1 in) Cold Hammer-Forged Barrel (6-Groove RH · 1:7" Twist), the IWI Tavor TAR-21 develops 910 m/s muzzle velocity and 1,655 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 550 meters.

Internally, 18.1-inch chrome-lined bore delivers full rifle velocity in a package shorter than an M4 carbine. Combined with its 750–900 RPM cyclic · CQB-optimized balance tempo, Rearward center of gravity allows crisp one-handed maneuvering inside armored vehicles, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 5.56×45mm NATO through its 460 millimeter bore, the IWI Tavor TAR-21 achieves 910 meters per second and 550 meters of effective reach. 18.1-inch chrome-lined bore delivers full rifle velocity in a package shorter than an M4 carbine.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 30-round 30-round detachable magazine body with a 42 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 5 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Designed around integrated reflex optics with fold-flat backup iron sights.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-46), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
acts.audioScript: Act Four: Engineering Legacy. Pairing its 30-round 30-round detachable magazine body with disciplined recoil geometry, Designed around integrated reflex optics with fold-flat backup iron sights. Explore BAY-46 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the IWI Tavor TAR-21.
